D: A young Black man visits his girlfriend's family for the weekend and uncovers something horrifying.
P: Serve the cereal when Rose eats her coloured cereal with the milk in a separate glass.
S: Marshmallow bars made with colored fruit cereal, served with cold milk

Crunchy rainbow fruit cereal set in brown butter and marshmallow, cut into bars and served with tall glasses of cold milk on the side. Melt 60g butter in a large pan and cook until it smells nutty. Add 300g marshmallows and a pinch of salt and stir until melted. Take off the heat and fold in 180g coloured fruit cereal quickly. Press into a lined 20cm square tin with a buttered spatula. Cool 1 hour, then cut into 16 bars. Serve with 4 tall glasses of cold milk, kept separate.
Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese
Blinis topped with crème fraîche, cold-smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest, and cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese and chives, laid on silver trays.
M: Lamb marinated overnight with garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled and rested
Butterflied lamb leg marinated overnight in garlic, rosemary, lemon and olive oil, grilled over high heat to 55C, rested 15 minutes, sliced with salsa verde.
the family dinner where Jeremy gets too loud

Herb-buttered roast chicken with crispy smashed potatoes, honey-glazed carrots and a pan gravy, the polite country house dinner that goes very wrong. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 50g butter mashed with thyme, garlic and lemon zest, under and over the skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes until 75C in the thigh, and rest. Boil 1kg baby potatoes, smash on a tray with oil and salt and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Roast 500g baby carrots with 1 tbsp honey and butter. Make gravy with the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Vanilla bean panna cotta set in teacups
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a split vanilla bean, set in teacups for 4 hours, a spoon of berry compote on top. Serve with a silver spoon.
K: Missy's spiced Earl Grey milk tea
Earl Grey simmered with cinnamon and cardamom, honey, topped with frothy milk

Earl Grey brewed strong with cinnamon and cardamom, sweetened with honey and finished with hot frothed milk, served in fine teacups with a silver spoon. Bring 600ml water to the boil with 1 cinnamon stick and 4 crushed cardamom pods and simmer 3 minutes. Take off the heat, add 4 Earl Grey tea bags and steep 4 minutes, then remove. Stir in 2 tbsp honey. Heat 400ml milk until steaming and whisk until frothy. Pour the tea into 4 teacups, top with the milk and serve with a silver teaspoon to stir.

s.note: Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest. Cut a cucumber into thick rounds and pipe on 120g goat's cheese whipped with chives. Lay both neatly on silver trays.

s.note: Marshmallow bars made with colored fruit cereal, served with cold milk
s.how: Melt 60g butter in a large pan and cook until it smells nutty. Add 300g marshmallows and a pinch of salt and stir until melted. Take off the heat and fold in 180g coloured fruit cereal quickly. Press into a lined 20cm square tin with a buttered spatula. Cool 1 hour, then cut into 16 bars. Serve with 4 tall glasses of cold milk, kept separate.

m.note: Lamb marinated overnight with garlic, rosemary and lemon, grilled and rested
m.how: Marinate a 1.5kg butterflied lamb leg overnight with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary, lemon and olive oil. Grill over high heat until 55C inside and rest 15 minutes. Chop parsley, capers, garlic and lemon with oil for salsa verde. Slice and spoon over.

w.note: Vanilla bean panna cotta set in teacups
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar and a split vanilla bean, then stir in the gelatine. Pour into 4 teacups and set 4 hours. Simmer 200g mixed berries with a spoon of sugar and spoon on top. Serve with silver spoons.
